description: Backends registered on this cloud-labs server. Users/scripts pick one at connect time; the server does not choose a default communicator from .env.

backends.label: Mock bench (default)
backends.description: Teaching edge via top-level mock_edge/ (in-process by default). Set edge.base_url to http://127.0.0.1:8100 when running `python -m mock_edge`.

backends.label: Lab automation (real robot)
backends.description: Physical robot bench via the Edge Contract server in the sibling lab_automation/cloudlabs_edge package.
backends.notes: Start the lab_automation edge on port 8200 before connecting. Coordinator lab_view holds VC + working state for this backend only; hardware geometry and commands come from the edge.

backends.label: Simulation edge (MuJoCo)
backends.description: MuJoCo / soft-pose simulation via simulation_edge/cloudlabs_edge. Default soft mode; set SIMULATION_EDGE_MUJOCO=1 for the viewer process. Point edge.base_url at http://127.0.0.1:8120 when serving `python -m simulation_edge`.
